latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of motion-video-maker for structured narration animation videos.

- Generates AE/PR-style animated explainer videos from text, scripts, or Markdown, with strict timing planning based on narration.
- Web interface for editing, previewing, and natural language modification before export.
- Exports MP4 only after explicit user confirmation; requires Playwright and ffmpeg for export.
- Supports modular workflows: scene splitting, narration-driven timing sync, template/theme choice, and optional TTS with user-confirmed voices.
- All configurations and edits are made via structured movie.json data; never overwrite with unstructured HTML.
- Includes detailed guides for workflow, editing, TTS setup, and visual style selection.
